park-city.imageAlt: Brown and green A-frame cabin with a wraparound deck, surrounded by pine trees
park-city.blurb: Built in 1965 and still stopping traffic — the silhouette guests screenshot before they even book.
features: Backs directly onto National Forest inside the gated Pine Mountain community
Wraparound deck spans two full sides of the house
Sits on a 0.57-acre wooded lot
Price already cut $40K — priced to move
park-city.hotTub: Claim the shaded side of the wraparound deck, facing into the trees — it's already built, level, and private from the road.
park-city.distance: The furthest of the three from the Old Town / Deer Valley revenue cluster (~21 mi, 35 min) — the trade-off for a genuine A-frame this far under budget.

park-city.imageAlt: Vaulted wood-ceiling dining nook opening onto a wraparound deck overlooking Rockport Reservoir
park-city.blurb: A fully remodeled log cabin that trades a formal dining room for a wall of glass — because the view is the whole point.
features: Wraparound deck suspended over Rockport Reservoir, lake and mountain views
Vaulted tongue-and-groove ceilings with a river-rock wood-burning fireplace
Walk-out basement adds flexible bonus space
Fully remodeled and move-in ready, not a fixer
park-city.hotTub: The far end of the deck past the dining nook keeps the same reservoir view as the glass wall, tucked away from the stairs down to the yard.
park-city.distance: Just 9.8 mi (20 min) from the high-revenue cluster — the closest of the three, and the easiest commute for owner visits.

park-city.address: 615 E Cherry Canyon Dr, Coalville, UT 84017
park-city.imageAlt: Long mountain lodge at sunset with a covered deck running the full length of the house
park-city.blurb: Built like a ski lodge, sized for a group buy — six bedrooms under one standing-seam roof.
features: Covered deck runs the entire length of the house
2.82 horse-friendly acres with an oversized 3-car garage
Stone accents and a standing-seam metal roof throughout
Walk-out basement leaves room for a future ADU
Listed at a 25-minute drive to Park City
park-city.hotTub: Anchor it at the far end of the covered deck, away from the garage entry — dry under the roofline year-round, with the whole valley laid out below.
park-city.distance: About 13.6 mi from the cluster — the listing itself puts it at a 25-minute drive to Park City.

st-george.address: 1206 N Horsemans Park Dr, Dammeron Valley, UT 84783
st-george.imageAlt: Stucco ranch home shaded by a mature tree on an open .64-acre horse property with no neighbors in sight
st-george.blurb: Real distance from the next house, not just a fence line — .64 acres of quiet horse country a half-hour from St. George.
features: Sits in Dammeron Valley, a sparsely populated horse-property community — actual open land between neighbors
.64-acre lot with room for horses, scenic Pine Valley Mountain views
24' x 36' detached garage/shop plus 30-amp RV parking
Comfortable single-level layout with an attached 2-car garage
st-george.hotTub: Plenty of open yard away from the house for a soak under genuinely dark, quiet skies — no neighboring patios to overlook it.
st-george.distance: 17.9 mi from the high-revenue cluster — priced and sized up from a typical entry-tier pick, because real acreage and real seclusion in this market cost more than a subdivision lot.

st-george.imageAlt: Tile-roofed stucco home in Ivins with the red cliffs of Snow Canyon rising behind it
st-george.blurb: New counters, new fixtures, and a 2,000-foot red cliff standing in for a backyard neighbor.
features: Fully fenced and landscaped yard, private on all sides
New quartz countertops, fixtures, and interior paint throughout
Oversized 3-car garage plus 2,084 sq ft to spread out
Minutes from Snow Canyon State Park and Tuacahn Amphitheatre
st-george.hotTub: The fenced backyard is already enclosed on all sides — tuck it along the back wall, out of sightline from both neighbors and the street.
st-george.distance: 14.6 mi from the cluster — the furthest of the three, traded for a private, fully fenced yard and the Snow Canyon views.

st-george.imageAlt: Private walled pool courtyard under a shaded pergola with desert mountain views beyond
st-george.blurb: The rare resort listing where the pool is actually yours — walled off from every other unit in the community.
features: Private covered patio enclosed by its own walls, with a swim spa
Fully furnished and turnkey — move in or rent night one
Whole-home fire suppression sprinkler system
Sand Hollow Resort access: 3 community pools, golf, clubhouse dining
st-george.hotTub: Already there: a private swim spa on the walled, pergola-shaded patio, fully screened from every neighboring unit — about as private as a couples' or group soak gets in a resort community.
st-george.distance: Just 1.7 mi from the high-revenue cluster — the closest of the three, inside a gated resort with pools, a clubhouse, and golf.
